title: Cancel a pending SQLite writer-admission ticket if a wait callback panics
outcome: A panic in a writer-admission wait callback releases its pending FIFO ticket so later writers on that database path can still make progress.
acceptance: A pending ticket is cancelled and the FIFO advances if wait_budget or interval_elapsed unwinds before admission is transferred to the writer guard.
A deterministic panic/unwind regression demonstrates that a later writer is admitted after either callback panics.
